questions.subject: Accountancy
questions.questionText: Partner X has a fixed capital of ₹4,00,000 on 1st April. On 1st October, X introduces additional capital of ₹1,00,000. The Partnership Deed provides for interest on capital @ 12% p.a. A student calculates interest as: (₹4,00,000 + ₹1,00,000) × 12% = ₹60,000. Explain why this calculation is incorrect and state the correct method.
